svg.title: Spectrum locus on the u prime v prime normalization plane, equal XYZ scales
svg.desc: The CIE 1931 2 degree spectrum locus is normalized onto X plus 15Y plus 3Z equals one, plotted with an orthographic isometric camera and a common scale for all three axes. Colored wavelengths and a dashed purple closure lie on a gray triangular plane. Axis tick spacing is 0.1 on every axis.
